# Why Are There Many Churches? Evidence Grid

**Lesson:** Y4-L21 - Why Are There Many Churches?

**Read:** 1 Corinthians 1:10-17; Ephesians 4:1-16

## Observe
- Record two direct observations from the passage.
- Identify relevant context and genre.

## Reason
- Test this big idea: Christian division has historical and theological causes, and unity requires truth, humility, and love.
- Label what is explicit text, synthesis/inference, framework position, or prudential application.

## Respond
- Name one faithful response that does not claim more than the evidence supports.

## Guardrail
- Do not caricature other Christian traditions or imply every division has the same cause.
purpose: Support the Why Are There Many Churches? lesson with an evidence-based evidence grid.
